name: Rotten Grasp
description: Calling upon the deep corruption underground, Deadwood roots enemies in the targeted area after a short delay, dealing Physical Damage over time and reducing Armor.

source.notes: From hon_reborn_slice.json. Delay gadget (Gadget_Deadwood_Ability1, lifetime 1200ms) spawns roots. Damage 100/150/200/250 is DoT over duration from the state. Level-up values are per-level [1,2,3,4].

adapted.adaptation_reason: Cooldown: ceil(13s / 5s) = 3 turns. Duration: ceil(1.5s / 5s) = 1 turn minimum (shortest level). Delay collapsed into the turn structure — effect resolves at end of cast turn. Range/radius collapse into row targeting: targets all enemies in a row. Damage taken as level-1 value; higher levels scale up. Energy cost kept 1:1 from mana cost (same resource rename). Armor reduction effect (-1 to -4) is an ActiveEffect applied separately.
